title: Chapter 426 The Demon King'S Thoughts
content:
Chapter 426 The Demon King'S Thoughts

"How do you want to form an alliance, lord?" Wang Shuo asked immediately.

Wang Hui replied: "At this time, Tiexue City is occupied by our three families. Although there has been no large-scale fighting, it is obvious that this state will not last long."

"Neither the demons nor we thought that Tiexue City would be so easily captured."

Wang Shuo thought to himself, of course it was easy, the boss was captured by me.

"So we are not ready to go to war with the demons."

Thinking of the strength of the demons, Wang Shuo couldn't believe it at this time. If the demons were to go to war with all their strength, what would be the consequences.

At least in terms of high-end combat power, they might be crushed.

"Our lord, I hope that Dahuai Territory can deploy troops to close the city, put pressure on Tiexue City and the demons, and make them dare not act rashly."

The words of the envoy hit Wang Shuo's heart.

Wang Shuo had discussed with Zhao Bangde before that the city must be heavily guarded.

Even if the envoy did not make this proposal, Wang Shuo would do so.

"No problem, we will guard the Guancheng."

"In addition, there is one more thing, Lord Dongfang, I hope to take Dongfang Ling back. Thank you very much for the care of Wang Junshou during this period!"

"Of course."

After sending the messenger away, Wang Shuo ordered someone to take the messenger to Dongfang Ling's military camp.

Next, Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng returned to Dahuai Territory to continue their retreat, and even Zhu Dongheng felt a sense of urgency.

Wang Shuo was stationed in Guancheng.

Wang Shuo immediately transferred a large number of craftsmen to prepare to build Guancheng into a fortress.

At the same time, several spies who had not been used before were sent out.

During this period, Wang Shuo had not contacted these people, and they had also cultivated their own forces.

Formed independent intelligence networks.

Wang Shuo believed that it would not be long before they would be able to send back information about Sunset City and Qingyang City.

Of course, what Wang Shuo wanted most now was information about the monster race, but the spies in his hands did not have monster beasts, so he only ordered Guan Jie and others to collect as much information about the monster race as possible.

...

The demon king's court.

In the depths of a huge mountain, the belly of the mountain has been hollowed out.

The skilled craftsmen of the demon clan built a magnificent palace inside the mountain.

In the depths of the palace is the retreat of the demon king.

Although the demon king is in retreat, he is not ignoring government affairs.

Every once in a while, he will ask his acting minister to come to his retreat to report the major events that have happened outside during this period.

If the retreat lasts for several months or years.

When he comes out of retreat, he may become a lonely man.

If he has such a mentality, he will not want to establish a hegemony of one side.

The demon king listened to the report of the acting minister Norn.

His closed eyes suddenly opened.

"Norn, what do you think?"

"I dare not speak nonsense."

Demon King Maris showed a wicked smile at the corner of his mouth.

"You said that we also go to lobby the Dahuai Territory to surrender, how sure are we?"

Norn was shocked, this... His Majesty's idea is really a bit different from ordinary people!

"Your Majesty, I think there is no certainty." Norn said cautiously.

"How can you know if you don't try everything?" The Demon King laughed, then handed Norn a piece of parchment, and then said: "Give this letter to the people in Dahuai Territory, hahahaha..."

Norn didn't dare to say more, took the parchment, and retreated.
